## Description

The owner decided (16 Nov 2026) that AI runs in a separate Python service, not a .NET worker. Bring the tested HealthOps scribe backend (FastAPI API, job worker, Alembic migrations, tests, evaluation harness, provider notes, decisions, threat model, runbook) into src/AiService as package medvya_ai. Record ADR-021 (supersedes the AI row of ADR-001). Add an ai-service CI job inside the required dotnet check: ruff, format, strict mypy, every test on real PostgreSQL 16, pip-audit. The HealthOps web app is not imported; Medvya builds its own screens (MDV-P3-029).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** ADR-021 records the decision, the development-only scope and the conditions before real patient data.
- [ ] **AC2.** src/AiService passes ruff, the format check and strict mypy; all unit, integration (PostgreSQL 16) and evaluation-replay tests pass in CI.
- [ ] **AC3.** In CI the integration tests fail, never skip, when the database is missing (shown failing without it).
- [ ] **AC4.** pip-audit reports no known vulnerabilities in the locked runtime dependencies; Dependabot watches src/AiService.
- [ ] **AC5.** No secret or real patient data is committed: .env.example lists names only, src/AiService/.env is ignored, check:synthetic and gitleaks pass.
- [ ] **AC6.** README repository structure, the ADR index and ai-pipeline.md point to the service.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
